messages:
alex: Quick coordination — I want to run a canary to validate the new fused+paged attention path on longer sequences (2k / 4k). Goal: measure steady throughput and tail latency with KV cache cold -> warm. Can anyone run microbenches on H100 + A100?

ops-bot: bench job template created: https://benchboard.internal/runs/1761504321 — use job names `canary/fused-paged/h100` and `canary/fused-paged/a100`. Artifacts will upload automatically.

lina: I can take H100-80. Plan: seq_len=2048,4096; batch=[1,2]; kv state: cold then 5 warm requests. ETA ~90m. Will capture nsys.

ben: On A100 I can kick off runs but FYI I hit OOM on batch=2, seq=4096 with fp16 + paged+fused in previous tries. If that happens I'll try q4_a8 quant or lower page_size. Also: are we toggling kernel prefetch? PR #1287 touches that.

sam: ping @ben — left comments on PR #1287 about the prefetch config and a missing fallback for small pages. Need a quick review before we trust the kernel selector. :eyes:

alex: Thanks. Please collect full nsight traces (nsys) and add NVTX markers around the attention call. Example command:```nsys profile -o out -t cuda,nvtx --force-nr-samples --capture-range=nvtx --sample=none python -m bench.run --config canary.json```Also dump `torch.cuda.memory_stats()` after the run.

lina: Started H100 runs. Early numbers (seq=2048, batch=1): fused-paged = 210 tok/s vs baseline 130 tok/s (measured tokens/s for generation with beam=1). For seq=4096, batch=1: fused-paged 95 tok/s vs baseline 60 tok/s. Cold-kv p99 is higher: ~18% regression on H100 for seq=4096. Uploading traces now. :upload:

ben: Thanks — can you also run with KV prefetch disabled (`PREFETCH_KV=0`) and with page_size=32k? I suspect copy-path congestion. If p99 drops with prefetch=0 that's a smoking gun. I'll run the A100 jobs with those flags too.

alex: Perfect. If p99 stays >10% on cold we may gate the rollout. I'll aggregate numbers into the perf dashboard and create a regression alert set tied to the canary runs. Once we have both H100 + A100 traces, I'll open a short postmortem-style note with suggested mitigations. :thumbsup:

bench-ci: artifacts uploaded: https://benchboard.internal/artifacts/1761504321 — logs, nsys (.qdrep), nvtx annotations, and a small csv of throughput/lats.

lina: Uploaded prefetch=0 runs too. Preliminary: disabling prefetch dropped p99 by ~9% on seq=4096 cold; throughput down ~3%. Sending full CSV.

ben: On A100 I could reproduce the OOM for batch=2/4096 with default page_size=64k. page_size=32k + prefetch=0 runs on A100 look similar to H100: throughput slightly lower but p99 better. I'll open a small kernel TODO to add an adaptive prefetch heuristic.

alex: Awesome work, team. Next steps: (1) bench-ci will mark canary as "needs review"; (2) @sam / @ben please iterate kernel PR with adaptive prefetch; (3) I'll hold canary rollout until we confirm p99 regression <=10% on cold. Thanks all.
